## History

The Twin Sailors were original characters created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in an imaginative composition written for his schoolteacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). In Paul's story, the twins were born on an island of palm trees, lived on a ship, sailed all over the world, and were eventually lost in a typhoon.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
